bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for hint text on checkout payment page
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the paragraph with class "hint" that reads "We never store your card details"
Inspect the computed styles for the text color and background
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background per WCAG 2.1 AA.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Text color #c4c4c4 on white background #ffffff yields a contrast ratio of 1.74:1, which fails the required minimum.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for p, change color from #c4c4c4 to #767676 (4.54:1 on #ffffff; measured 1.74:1, required 4.5:1).

_severity_override.rule: CLAUDE.md: checkout flow violations are always critical

bugLogs.title: Image submit button missing accessible name on checkout payment page
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the Pay Now button rendered as <input type="image">
Attempt to navigate to the button using only the keyboard or a screen reader
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The image button must have a text alternative (alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or associated label) so assistive technologies can announce its purpose.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <input type="image" src="pay-now.png" width="120" height="40"> element has no alt attribute, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, no title, and no associated label, providing no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an accessible name, e.g., <input type="image" src="pay-now.png" width="120" height="40" alt="Pay now" aria-label="Pay now"> or provide a <label for="payNowBtn">Pay now</label> and id="payNowBtn" on the input.

bugLogs.title: Select element #promo lacks an accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Attempt to navigate to the dropdown with a screen reader
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select control should have a programmatically determinable name that is announced by assistive technologies (e.g., via a visible label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <select id="promo"> element has no associated <label>, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, and no title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label and associate it with the select, e.g., <label for="promo">Promo code</label> before the <select>, or add aria-label="Promo code" to the select element.

bugLogs.title: Missing persistent label for payment name input
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the checkout payment page
bugLogs.expected_behavior: A visible, persistent label is associated with the input so screen readers announce it and the label remains visible when the user types.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The input has only a placeholder text and no <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title, causing the label to disappear on focus and providing no programmatic name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a <label> element linked to the input and optionally keep the placeholder. Example: <label for="pay-name">Name on card</label><input type="text" id="pay-name" placeholder="Name on card">
